properties.sfomuseum:description: Handwritten letter from Harold M. Bixby to his wife, Debby Bixby, dated April 26, [likely 1947], in Washington [D.C.]; includes brief description of meeting with Secretary of Treasury [John Wesley] Snyder, meeting with J.T.T. [Juan Trippe]; attempts to meet with Japanese officials for a “Tokyo deal”; mentions Kitsie Bond and Bondy [William L. Bond], Chairman Gaston of the Import-Export Bank, Sam Pryor.
